managers._note: Sanity-check only. Actual roster is read live from the FPL API each sync.

epithet_overrides._note: Season-specific manual pins for epithet judgment calls the linear ruleset can't express. Review/clear each season.

run_in._note: The Run In tab shows the latest archived season as a finished story until the current season reaches run_in_threshold (GW10), then defaults to the current season with archives available via dropdown. run_in_threshold is the single source of truth — never hardcode the GW elsewhere.

sections.heading: Joining Fee
sections.body: R300 per member. Used to book a venue for the UEFA Champions League final viewing. Due by 30 September 2026. Failure to pay results in gameweek fines being accrued (R150 per GW) until payment is made.

sections.heading: Last Man Paying — Weekly Fines
sections.body: Each gameweek, the three teams with the lowest scores pay R100 each. If there is a tie at the third, second, or first lowest score, all tied teams pay.

sections.heading: Fines
sections.body: The default fine for any rule violation not otherwise specified is R150. This is separate from the R100 weekly Last Man Paying contribution.

sections.heading: Payment References
sections.body: All EFT payments must be referenced correctly using your name followed by 'FPL' — e.g. 'Sthe FPL'. Failure to reference correctly results in a fine.

sections.heading: Payment Deadline
sections.body: Where these rules refer to a 'deadline', this means the official FPL gameweek deadline, not match kick-off.

sections.heading: Treasurer's Reconciliation
sections.body: The treasurer must complete a reconciliation at the end of every gameweek, before the next gameweek begins.

sections.heading: Team Activation
sections.body: Failure to activate a team or join the league by Gameweek 1 results in a fine.

sections.heading: Deadline Reminders
sections.body: No reminders are sent in the two hours before an FPL deadline. Managers are responsible for managing their own teams on time; failure to do so may result in a fine.

sections.heading: End of Season Penalty
sections.body: The player with the lowest aggregate score at the end of the season pays an additional R250.

sections.heading: Payment Schedule
sections.body: Payments are split into two this season. First payment is due at the end of Gameweek 19 (BEFORE GAMEWEEK 20 BEGINS). Failure to pay by the deadline results in R150 accruing for each subsequent gameweek (from the start of GW20). Reference your EFT with your name followed by 'FPL' — e.g. 'Sthe FPL'.

sections.heading: Leaving the League
sections.body: Members who wish to leave after Gameweek 18 may do so, but must pay the amount accumulated plus an additional 150% of that amount. They will also not be allowed to attend future events unless they comply with this rule.

sections.heading: The Venue
sections.body: The person at the bottom of the log at the end of GW19 is responsible for finding the venue for the final by 31 January 2027. The venue must be in Gauteng and must be approved by the person at the top of the log at the end of GW19. Failure to find a venue by 31 January 2027 results in R150 fines per gameweek until finalised.

sections.heading: Final Accommodation
sections.body: The Final festivities and accommodation now run for two days. Day 1 is self-catering.

sections.heading: Male Guests
sections.body: Male guests wishing to watch along must pay the average contribution made throughout the season (determined at season end).

sections.heading: Female Guests — Day 1
sections.body: Female guests are permitted on Day 1 but must vacate by 13:00 on Day 2 (the day of the Final). Failure to comply results in a fine equal to the average contribution for the season, carried over to the following season.

sections.heading: Female Guests — Final
sections.body: Female guests may join the festivities after the 90th-minute final whistle.

sections.heading: The Winner
sections.body: Selects alcohol of their choice to be consumed during the Champions League final. Receives a football jersey as a reward — strictly replica / fan jersey, no authentics.

sections.heading: Mini / Squire Rule
sections.body: The Squire (the bottom-placed manager) serves the winner and must be the first person to check in on the day of the festivities. Failure to check in first results in a fine equal to the average contribution for the season, carried over to the following season. If the Squire is unavailable due to circumstances beyond their control, the duties fall to the second-biggest loser.

sections.heading: Bottom 3 Working Committee
sections.body: The bottom three managers at the end of the season form the Working Committee for the Final (the Squire is one of the three), responsible for purchasing ice, braai duties, and other administrative/logistical requirements. Duties must be discussed and delegated amongst the three members.

sections.heading: Force Majeure
sections.body: If COVID-19 or a similar event interrupts the games, these rules remain in place. No concessions or force majeure will be applied.

sections.heading: Banking Details
sections.body: Refer to the banking block in any reminder email, or the league treasurer. Reference: {first_name} FPL.

secrets._note: These are NOT stored here. Set as environment variables in Vercel (and GitHub Actions where needed): TREASURER_PASSWORD, RESEND_API_KEY. Email addresses live in a gitignored emails file, also injected via secret.
